---
title: Fried ricotta
id: MAR-0064
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g ricotta
- 60 g all-purpose flour
- 1 egg
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Drain the ricotta, completely removing any whey.
2. Cut it into cubes of about 4 cm on each side.
3. Pass, a little at a time, the ricotta cubes in the beaten egg and then in the flour, removing the excess, and place them in hot oil.
4. Turn them once and drain them when they are golden.
5. Place the ricotta cubes on kitchen paper towels, salt and serve.
